title: pg.zig SCRAM-SHA-256 authentication failure blocks all integration tests on main
symptom: All zig build test-integration targets fail with PgError.AuthenticationFailed at vendor/pg/pg.zig:451. Verified on plain origin/main (fd7f8eb8) — iss107 fails 0/5 with identical error.
root_cause: Unknown. Pre-existing systemic failure in pg.zig SCRAM-SHA-256 auth path. Suspected causes: (a) bpm user password hash mismatch with PostgreSQL pg_authid row, (b) SCRAM mechanism negotiation mismatch between pg.zig client and PostgreSQL 15+ server, (c) test-integration environment variables not setting SCRAM-required channel binding.
impact: Integration test count drops to 113/927 pass on main; 804 blocks fail with same auth error. Blocks verification of any integration-touching fix.
reproducer: git checkout fd7f8eb8; docker-compose up -d db db_test keycloak; BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5434/bpm_test zig build test-integration-iss107
fix_target: Diagnose root cause (likely in vendor/pg/pg.zig SCRAM path or in BPM_DB_URL config in src/db/provisioning.zig). Apply minimal fix. Add regression test that proves integration tests connect successfully end-to-end.
